tasks.label: Publish Jellyfin Plugin (Release)
args: if ((Get-Content JellyEmu.csproj -Raw) -match '<Version>(?<v>[^<]+)</Version>') { $ver = $Matches['v']; $manifest = Get-Content manifest.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $manifest.version = $ver; $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content manifest.json -Encoding utf8; Write-Host 'Synchronized manifest.json version to '$ver }; dotnet build -c Release
tasks.detail: Compiles the Jellyemu plugin and syncs manifest version from csproj.
